question: Should `steipete/homebrew-tap` officially support Nameplate on Linux through a maintained Homebrew formula?
rationale: The technical path is bounded, but accepting it commits the project to cross-repository formula updates, Linux dependency declarations, and upgrade support for future releases.

options.title: Support Linuxbrew
options.body: Add and maintain a Linux formula in the project tap, with documentation and release smoke checks.

options.title: Keep tarballs only
options.body: Retain direct Linux archives as the supported install path and decline the additional package-manager maintenance commitment.

recommendation.title: Support Linuxbrew
recommendation.body: Add and maintain a Linux formula in the project tap, with documentation and release smoke checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The Linux port, release artifact contract, and existing Homebrew tap path all originate from this owner's work.
